headline: Fincantieri Secures 500 Million Euro Contract for Navy Logistics Unit
summary: Fincantieri won a contract worth 500 million euros, including an 88 million euro option, to build a third LSS logistics support unit for the Italian Navy.
why: Fincantieri is a major Italian shipbuilding conglomerate and a leading global builder of naval surface vessels.

impacts.name: Fincantieri SpA
impacts.why: Large naval shipbuilding orders bolster corporate order books and future revenue.
